newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sell $103.50/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sell $103.50/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday were trading at $103.50 per cwt on a dressed basis in light volume, steady with the bulk of last week's sales, market sources said.
About 1,000 head sold, with some cattle sold early in the morning going to plants in the afternoon, the sources said.
Further bids at $103.50 were resisted by owners who were passing on the bids and pricing cattle at $104.00.
There were no reported trades or bids on a live basis, but asking levels were at $64.00.
